string_encoding: u32 little endian byte length followed by UTF-8 bytes
element_record: string name; string sprite_name; u32 z_order
action_record: string name; f32 fps; u32 frame_count; frames
frame_record: u32 event_count; events; u32 element_count; elements
event_record: u32 type; string argument; 8 x f32; u32 flags
frame_element_record: u16 element_id; u8 alpha; 6 x f32 affine matrix (27 bytes)
native_duplicate_id_rule: last transform/alpha/z_order for the same node wins
png_pixels: original RGBA8888 or RGBA4444 expanded to RGBA8888; no color/style edits
render_limitations: Sprite body timeline only; external event-triggered effects, sound, gameplay shaders and battle state are not simulated.
